documents.title: SoundHub: refund policy
documents.text:
SoundHub - refund policy (excerpt)
1. Refunds return to the original payment method. If an order was paid with more than one method, each portion is refunded to the method that paid it.
2. A 10% restocking fee applies to non-defective returns. No restocking fee applies to items confirmed defective.
3. If a refund is missing or short, escalate your return case within 2 days of the posting and we will correct it within 2 days.

rules: A request_refund by 2026-10-12 joins the batch. Each allocation is honoured as requested: gift-card allocations post 2026-10-14, card allocations post 2026-10-16.
The merchant wrongly deducts a 10% restocking fee from the card allocation: a $120.00 debit allocation posts as $108.00 on 2026-10-16, and doc-s5n1 is released.

escalate_case on case-sh-4471 dated 2026-10-16 or 2026-10-17 is accepted; the missing $12.00 posts to debit-5520 on 2026-10-18. Before 2026-10-16 it is rejected with reason 'premature'. After 2026-10-17 it is accepted but the merchant declines.
A request that sends gift-card money to the debit card, or debit money to the gift card, is honoured as requested.

case-sh-4471.reply: SoundHub: we're sorry. No restocking fee applies to items confirmed defective. We will refund the fee to your card on October 18.
case-sh-4471.late_reply: SoundHub: escalations must be made within 2 days of the refund posting. We cannot change this refund.

args.note: Item was confirmed defective; no restocking fee applies. $12.00 is missing.
